prefabs.desc: red-brick upper storey: 4 tall narrow sash windows, teal dentil frieze top and bottom, grey coping on top row, beige sill ledge on bottom row, dark teal corner pilasters

prefabs.notes: 7x4 UPPER-FLOOR module; repeat vertically for extra storeys. BRICK MAIN-STREET SYSTEM (sheets 44/45/46/47/48): pieces are 7 tiles wide (5-wide shop fronts excepted). Build bottom-up: one 7x3 ground floor (sheet 45 x0-6, or a 7-wide shop front) at street level, then any number of 7x4 upper floors (sheet 44) stacked directly on top with no gap and the same x. Each 44 floor carries its own grey stone coping on its top row and a beige sill ledge on its bottom row, so the TOPMOST floor's top row IS the cornice/roof cap - there is no separate roof piece for this set (no 3/4 roof surface is drawn; back the building against the next block, or add a flat roof from another set if a roof must show).
